_comment: Copy to /etc/blockle-settlement/config.json (or point SETTLEMENT_CONFIG at it). All USD/BLOCK amounts here are WHOLE units; the engine converts to base units. NEVER commit a real privateKey — prefer the SETTLEMENT_RESERVE_KEY env var. Mainnet payouts require BOTH mainnetEnabled:true AND legalReview.completed:true.

legalReview.notes: Operator MUST obtain legal/compliance sign-off before enabling mainnet.
